scope: Real-backend million-row/one-MiB functional smoke with short calibration; no five-minute capacity or four-hour endurance certification. Maximum object bytes in invariants is the read bound, not measured content length.

profile.resource_protocol: component cgroup v2, PostgreSQL IO/WAL/checkpointer/locks, process owners; allocated du totals count only disappearing child entries
profile.arrival_counter_protocol: continuous sparse scheduler counters; 120s lookback; maximum 30s polling gap; bounded phase state
